items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Carl Crest and all those guys were the big ones then.

ctx.x: And so he told Snoozer, he said, you'll hear, you'll hear from me. And nobody paid any attention to it, you see. So Snoozer gave him my address at Karns, because Snoozer was going back to Bogalusa, you see. So Snoozer gave him my address at Karns and told him that if he wanted to get in touch with him, get in touch with him through me, you see. And I had Snoozer's address in Bogalusa. It's New Year's Eve night and we're playing, like I told you, the dinner where the blue room is. And that was a Venetian room…

Because guys like all the music, everybody that heard of him, the musicians, oh, they wouldn't go up to his hotel room, the poor guy could never sleep. But guys like Eddie Lang and all those guys, Dick McDonough was there, Carl Crest and all those guys were the big ones then. And then all the guys had the guy playing night and day and he was the kind of guy that couldn't say no, you know, never could say no to you. And did you ever see him?
